📣 W3C and Marsh are excited to announce the Dublin Developer Meetup! Held alongside TPAC 2026, the event brings together Dublin’s developer community and @w3c members for inspiring tech talks by @tink, @Yoav and @patrickbrosset.

Register now and join us on Monday 26 October in #Dublin 🇮🇪
▶️ https://www.w3.org/events/meetups/2026/dublin-developer-meetup/

Participation in the meetup is open to everyone at no cost. Space is limited!

We gratefully thank Marsh for hosting the event.

#w3cTPAC #WebPerformance #AI #a11y #WebMCP
